text: Dax (use grow), a term to the wet of the fource of the Jordan’s formerly called Leair (Jofhan, Judges, Jofaphus). This was the north, as Berichholz was the fourth, bounded of the patient, as appears from the common expection in Scripture, from Dar to Beefhe- ha. At Dan Jeradeam credited one of the golden calers (1 King size).
